hypothesis_title: What English-tuned abliteration misses in Slovene
Slovene refusal needs a deeper edit

strands.why: Keyword proxy near-exact on originals (FP .015/.027) but inverts on the edits it selects (gemma_edit .851 keyword vs .255 judged, FP .761, kappa -.04); 4,800 gens, audited 127/127+173/173.
Pre-registered r_prior test failed (cut .036 < random .074); post-freeze depth result is controlled: SL .86->.10 all-48 vs random .86 / PC .93, and c=2 at one site leaves SL .75. One model.
Over 163 edits, compliance log-prob rises equally in both languages (slope .849) but the refusal opener falls only in EN (.081); all frozen predictions NOT CONFIRMED, Gap_R1 .054 inside placebo.
Gap_K .147 [.074,.265], B_K CI excludes 0, but only .018 on journal trials, SL KL smaller (.59), reverse -.124; exposure carrier failed; source-layer lead rho .77 is post-freeze.
Utility null by design (macro <=0.20 pts). Leads: Gemma SL needs ~2x edit strength; GaMS3 re-encoding (refit .993/.987) vs Gemma intact representation with an EN-only readout change.

hypothesis_title: Where the edit lands, not how deep

strands.why: At matched energy AND matched layer count, placement decides: SL 0.24 vs 0.81 (E3), CIs exclude 0, Holm p 0.000; nested R2 placement 0.718 vs count 0.400; controls null; 481/481 re-derived.
Keyword counter never leaves 72-100/100 across all 116 draws while judged refusal spans 7-98/100; MAE 30.6 vs 2.1 per 100; kappa +0.196 vs 0.858 certified; 11,600 in-loop gens, 305/305 audited.
P1/P2 rejected under power (dR2 0.040, LOO -0.002, MDE 0.071). Band-density rho -0.942 survives placebo but SL regression coefficient +0.156 [-0.240, 0.529]; one model, exploratory.
Index claim dead (rho -0.009 over 21 rows), but two cheap baselines beat it and cosine with CIs excluding 0 (rho +0.732, +0.661); judge below its own gate at kappa 0.683.
Executed bound on our own headline: strict gap +.22-+.71 vs broad -.04-+.37, S5X +.69 -> +.23, PARTIAL .548; 8 mismatches and 2 sign-reversals in 167 numbers; within-edited kappa .779 vs .913 pooled.

hypothesis_title: Where the edit lands beats how hard it hits

strands.why: Placement at matched energy AND count: 8/8 groups both languages, EN -0.69 [-0.75,-0.62], SL -0.38; 16-31 vs 33-48 EN 0.07 vs 0.92; 2x dose of wrong band still 0.88/0.92; controls null; Qwen3 9/9.
Placement replicates (rho -0.903, dR2 0.580 over logE, controls null) but the instrument LOSES to cheap baselines (band4 0.845, cos 0.834 vs O 0.594) and the DEV argmax band lost: NAMED_AND_LOST.
Frozen GBF prediction FALSIFIED (+0.006 [0,0.019]; judge-ref reverses -0.029). Real but non-discriminative: TBF 1.00 in both searches, floor 72 vs 16, low-region GBF 0.47 vs 0.02.
C3 FALSIFIED (Delta_peak +.45 [-.45,.90]; C3-iii rho -.43 p .34). Surviving executed signal: SL non-refusals guard-safe more often than EN, +0.232 [0.124,0.348]; SL judge gate still missed (.723).
Evidenced absence for the matched-energy+matched-count contrast (8 logged queries), but narrows us: 2607.02714 finds uniform spread beats norm-selected by ~70pp and must be reconciled.

hypothesis_title: Where the edit lands beats how hard it hits

strands.why: Independent stdlib recompute reproduces placement at matched energy AND count: Gemma 8/8 EN -0.688/SL -0.377, GaMS3 rho -0.90, Qwen3 9/9, dose rival fails (.88/.92 vs .07/.27); 8/8 placebos collapse.
Second independent path reproduces the same placement numbers and guard-safe +0.231, but its own headline is an integrity result: 14/121 claims fail, 9 paths dead, 12 claims on an ungated judge.
Executed and clean (Delta_lang -1.56 [-1.68,-1.44]; 0/490 SL firings; TBF 1.00; 573/573 rederived) but the EN over-count half is published (2510.02768) and the SL judge gate is unmet (0.723).
Keeps the delta (matched energy+count, failed dose rival, Qwen3) with six evidenced absences, but narrows it: 2408.17003 already localises contiguous mid-depth safety layers by scaling ranges.
